note: The screening room. still: the room picture with the big screen and both monitors in flat green (a frame of the loop). loop: the character video made from it (same framing, camera locked); leave it empty to show the still. editor: the editing-app picture for the left monitor, and the box inside it (left, top, right, bottom as fractions) where the video plays. quads: leave null and the room finds the three green screens by itself. aspect: the real shape of each screen (width / height).
